chunks: Then as for he who was rebellious

key_terms.طَغَىٰ: Transgressed or rebelled against divine limits

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about those who were rebellious (tagha)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'man tagha' (he who transgressed) specifically refers to those who exceeded the limits set by divine law, often linked to the concept of *ghuluw* (exaggeration) or persistent disobedience. This phrase initiates a dichotomy between the righteous who purify their souls and the transgressors who neglect their spiritual growth, highlighting the causal link between moral conduct and eternal destiny.
